notes.title: House Builder 2 Release Date & Closed Playtests
notes.notes:
[h2] Hi Builders! 🏗️👷👷‍♀️ 
[/h2][p]We’ve got two major announcements today – so grab your helmets and tools 🛠️[/p][hr][/hr][h2]📅 Official Release Date[/h2][p]We’re excited to confirm that [b][i]House Builder 2[/i] will launch on October 22, 2025![/b] 🎉
That’s when everyone will finally get the chance to dive into the next generation of building.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="BvPdEpx_4Vc;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h2]🚨 Closed Playtests – Starting Today![/h2][p]But you don’t have to wait until October to get your hands on the game…
[b]Closed playtests start TODAY![/b]
Selected players will get the chance to test the new mechanics early and help us polish the experience before release.[/p][p]Here’s what you can expect in the playtests:[/p][list][*][p]🔨 [b]New tools & materials[/b] – more ways to design and build[/p][/*][*][p]🌍 [b]Larger environments[/b] – construct homes in diverse settings[/p][/*][*][p]🏠 [b]Improved building mechanics[/b] – deeper, more immersive than ever[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Enhanced visuals & physics[/b] – more realistic and satisfying construction[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]👀 Why a Sequel?[/h2][p]The first [i]House Builder[/i] showed us how much you love creating homes from the ground up. With [i]House Builder 2[/i], we wanted to expand every aspect – from details of construction, through bigger worlds, to a smoother and more engaging building flow.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🗓️ What’s Next[/h2][list][*][p]Ongoing closed playtests & feedback collection[/p][/*][*][p]More devlogs revealing new features and behind-the-scenes looks[/p][/*][*][p]Final launch on [b]October 22, 2025[/b] 🚀[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💬 Join the Community[/h2][p]Your feedback is invaluable – it helps us shape the best possible version of [i]House Builder 2[/i].
Tell us: [i]what’s the first house you’d love to build in HB2?[/i][/p][p]Thank you for supporting us since the very beginning – let’s build something amazing together! 🏡[/p][p][/p][p]— The [i]House Builder 2[/i] Team Try out our new, premiere DLC for House Builder 1: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967780/House_Builder__Egyptian_DLC/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: HOTFIX #4🏚️➡️🏡✅
notes.notes:
[h2] Hi Builders! 🏗️

New fixes according to reports😃📶💙  [/h2]

[b]🔶Hand waving while moving improved - now it will be much more aesthetic :D
🔶Map optimisation
🔶Car physics improved - they should no longer react so strongly to their surroundings

notes.title: FIRST DEMO UPDATE! #1👷👷‍♀️
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi Builders!🏗️

Thanks to your suggestions, first HOTFIX is here! Thank you very much for your reports 💌
Here are the changes: [/h2]

[b]🔹 player position reset button in pause menu - now when you lock yourself out, 
you can free yourself 🦋

🔹 less traffic - cars were bumping into each other or you? 😶 That's a thing of the past 😀

🔹 demolition sounds when you're working with a hammer 🔨 

🔹 Improved hammer action 🔨 - you can now smash a fence from any angle 

🔹 Improved far camera operation - arrow now always visible on the horizon ⬇️

🔹 crouching now works properly - previously you were flying into the air 🐬 

🔹 Improved loading area physics - objects will no longer fall out of the car so easily 🌐:
[previewyoutube=oEijTHMJUSs;full][/previewyoutube]
🔹 ability to rotate items you bought [R]

🔹 shortcuts 1,2,3,4,5 work now - you don't have to use the scrollbar to select items!

🔹 sleep is only until 9am - you can't sleep any longer, consequently there will be no situations where sleep could be followed by night 🌚

🔹 pop-up with thanks after opinion

🔹 and a few minor problems/improvements 🐛[/b]

We don't stop and we keep going. More updates coming soon 😀

⤵️⤵️⤵️

❗️ Remember - These are the first days of the demo. Gameplay errors can happen! Therefore, we look forward to your feedback. Most bugs are being fixed thanks to your reports ❗️
